selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the first special gain a garden worker can get with a good intention?
questions.answer: The worker shares in the worship and praise made by the plants and trees.

questions.question: Which living things in the garden are included in that first gain?
questions.answer: Trees and plants with flowers or fruit are included.

questions.question: What is the second special gain from the garden produce?
questions.answer: Food taken from the garden can count like charity from the worker.

questions.question: Who may eat from the garden and still make that reward happen?
questions.answer: People, animals, bugs, buyers, and even thieves.

questions.question: What must the worker do so the garden work becomes like charity?
questions.answer: Work for Allah, stay within what Allah allows, and know the goods belong to Allah.

questions.question: How should the worker think about his job in the garden?
questions.answer: He should see himself as someone handing out Allah’s gifts to His creatures.

questions.question: What does a person lose by leaving the required prayers?
questions.answer: The person loses great reward and misses the two special gains.

questions.question: How can missing prayer hurt a person’s feelings about work later in life?
questions.answer: The person may get tired of the work, stop caring, and become lazy.

questions.question: Why does the praying person keep working with energy?
questions.answer: He hopes for more light for the grave and more provision for the next life.

questions.question: What two kinds of work does the hopeful person want to do more of?
questions.answer: Worship and lawful daily work.

questions.question: In the passage, what makes a person receive reward from the plants and trees?
questions.answer: Having a sincere and sound intention.

questions.question: Does the first reward come only from fruit trees? Name the kinds mentioned.
questions.answer: No. It comes from both flowering and fruit-bearing plants and trees.

questions.question: If garden food is eaten, what can it become for the worker?
questions.answer: It can become like giving charity.

questions.question: Which is needed for that reward: any kind of work, or work done in Allah’s name and in a halal way?
questions.answer: Work done in Allah’s name and in a halal way.

questions.question: Why is it important to remember that the garden goods belong to Allah?
questions.answer: It helps the worker stay humble and act like a helper, not an owner over everything.

questions.question: What big mistake does the passage warn about when someone leaves the daily prayers?
questions.answer: That person throws away great reward and misses valuable blessings.

questions.question: What kind of thoughts may an older person have after leaving prayer for a long time?
questions.answer: The person may think the work is not worth it because life in this world will end anyway.

questions.question: What bad habit can grow from those thoughts?
questions.answer: Idleness and not wanting to work.

questions.question: What does the better person hope to send ahead by working harder?
questions.answer: More light for the grave and more supplies for the hereafter.

questions.question: What makes the first man keep striving?
questions.answer: He wants reward for the grave and the hereafter, so he works more in worship and lawful jobs.

questions.question: What is one reward for a gardener who works with the right purpose in the heart?
questions.answer: The gardener gets a share in the remembrance and praise done by the garden’s plants and trees.

questions.question: What part of the garden is talked about in that reward?
questions.answer: The growing plants and trees, including ones with blossoms and fruits.

questions.question: When food from the garden is taken, what good deed can it be counted as?
questions.answer: It can be counted like charity.

questions.question: Name two groups from the passage that may take the produce.
questions.answer: Buyers and thieves.
